topic: Chinese labs and open models: Kling (Kuaishou), Hailuo/MiniMax, ByteDance Seedance, Alibaba Wan, Tencent HunyuanVideo, Vidu (ShengShu), Zhipu CogVideoX. Verified against primary sources through 2026-09-29.
method_notes: Primary pages were fetched from the Higgsfield sandbox (curl, headless Chromium for JS-rendered Kling release notes, HF/GitHub APIs, cdn.syndication.twimg.com for official X posts). Every quote below was machine-checked as a substring of the retrieved page text (typographic quotes/markdown asterisks normalised). Official X posts are labelled official_blog and are the developer's own account. Wire press releases issued by the developer (PR Newswire / Kuaishou) are labelled official_blog with a note where the copy was read on a mirror. Anything only found in secondary sources is labelled secondary or listed under unverified_leads.

milestones.headline: Kuaishou opened applications for early-access testing of Kling, a text-to-video model billed as a Sora rival, in China.

specs.notes: Company launch claim relayed by MIT Technology Review (secondary): up to two minutes, 30 fps, up to 1080p. Kuaishou's own 25 Jul 2024 release says text-to-video was only extended to 10 seconds by the July upgrade, so the 2-minute figure is a launch claim, not evidence of typical output length.

claims.claim: Kuaishou's own July 2024 release says Kling began accepting applications on 6 June 2024 (invitation beta; >1 million applications, >300,000 granted early access).
claims.quote: since it began accepting applications on June 6

claims.claim: Launch-day spec claim (quoting Kling's own website): up to 2 minutes, 30 fps, up to 1080p. Secondary relay; not corroborated by a primary page I could retrieve.
claims.quote: up to two minutes long with a frame rate of 30fps and video resolution up to 1080p

milestones.notes: Date confirmed by the issuer press release (nasdaq.com hosts the PR Newswire copy of Kuaishou Technology's release dated 25 Jul 2024; official IR host kuaishou.gcs-web.com was unreachable). Spec claims are medium/low confidence.

corrections_to_common_beliefs: Seedance 2.5 is real: ByteDance Seed's own blog dated 2026-07-31 announces it (30 s per generation, 30 images + 10 videos + 10 audio references). Seedance 2.0's official blog is dated 2026-02-12.
Seedance 2.0 is often described as natively high-resolution. Its technical report says direct generation is 4-15 s with native 480p and 720p; BytePlus lists higher resolution options.
Kling 3.0: the official X announcement is 2026-02-04, the release-note entry is displayed as 2026-01-31, and the API launch is dated 2026-02-25; do not quote a single unqualified date.
Kling 2.5 Turbo's official release note is 2025-09-19 (some sources say 23 Sep) and Kling 2.1's is 2025-05-26 (some sources say 29 May).
Kling 2.6 (2025-12-03) was Kling's first native-audio model, but Wan 2.5-Preview (2025-09-24) announced native audio earlier; Kling had post-hoc integrated sound effects from 2025-06-26.

Kling 1.0 began as an early-access beta (applications opened 2024-06-06; more than 300,000 users granted access by July) and opened to global web users on 2024-07-24; the 'two-minute 1080p' launch figure was a claim, while the July 2024 Kuaishou release describes 10-second text-to-video.
Kling 1.5's Motion Brush appeared 2024-09-19, but the 1.5 Professional-mode I2V Motion Brush plus Camera Movement combination was re-announced 2024-11-22 and the V1.5 Pro API opened 2024-11-15.
Kling 4.0 is only announced (2026-09-28) with limited Flash early access; the full launch is stated for October 2026 and HDR is 'coming soon'.

Hailuo Video-01 launched 2024-08-31 per MiniMax's own post (720p, 25 fps, up to 6 s), not September 2024; Hailuo 02 (2025-06-18) is native 1080p; Hailuo 2.3 is 2025-10-28; the current model is MiniMax H3 (2026-07-31), not 'Hailuo 3' as the official name.
MiniMax H3 'open weights' come with a custom community licence that excludes the EU, UK, South Korea and the United States; it is not Apache/MIT.

Wan is open-weights only through Wan2.1 (2025-02-25, Apache-2.0) and Wan2.2 (2025-07-28, Apache-2.0) plus specialised Animate/Dancer models; Wan 2.5, 2.6, 2.7 and 3.0 are API/hosted products with no base weights found. Wan 3.0 public beta is 2026-08-06 (30-second clips).
HunyuanVideo (2024-12-03) and HunyuanVideo-1.5 (2025-11-20) are 'open' under the Tencent Hunyuan Community License, which does not apply in the EU, UK and South Korea; it is not OSI open source.

CogVideoX: only the 2B model is Apache-2.0 (2024-08-06); 5B models use a separate CogVideoX licence; CogVideoX-3 (Z.ai release note dated 2025-07-15) is a proprietary API. The paper's 10 s / 16 fps / 768x1360 figures are higher than the released 2B model (6 s, 8 fps, 720x480).

Vidu's own press releases date its launch to April 2024 and commercial availability to July 2024; its Q3 model (Jan 2026) is 16-second native audio-video at 1080p, and S1/S2 (2026) are real-time interactive models, not clip generators.
